findings.key_quote: Cost of energy generation and storage revenue increased $1.52 billion, or 20%, in the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024, primarily from increases in Megapack and Powerwall deployments
findings.justification: This evidence is for the exact claim period (FY2025, year ended December 31, 2025). It states that cost of energy generation and storage revenue increased primarily from increases in Megapack and Powerwall deployments. Combined with E13 showing gross profit increased from $2,640M (2024) to $3,802M (2025), this establishes that higher Megapack deployments (along with Powerwall) drove the growth in gross profit.
